# AP onboarding notes

- Invoices arrive at ap@corp.example and are logged the same day.
- Invoices over $5,000 need approval from Jordan Lee before payment.
- Payment runs happen every Friday; the list for each run is in /shared/ap/payment_run.md.
- Vendor bank details come only from the vendor master, never from an email.
